column1: # The shrink victim (P/04 Н3 «сократить()», the victim; ADR-0084 addendum (1) Р4, addendum (2) Р22, addendum (6)). Form — README alongside. Stage A (A6); the input with want — analysis of review of stage B 6–7, № 42.

column4: note
the base -1 is never a victim
the only ordered one
the number — as an integer: 10 is greater than 9 (Р4), not by the slot order
the greatest number among the servers
a server name with «-» and a digit: the number — after the server name
equal numbers on different servers — the smaller server name in UTF-8 bytes first
equal numbers: the smaller server name in UTF-8 bytes first — srv-1 < srv-10, an own prefix before its continuation (P/03.2 Н1.4; reconciliation М10/3–5, V1; analysis of review of stage B 3–5, № 33)
a number with a leading zero — input out of form (Р22)
the name names another server — input out of form (Р22)
number 3 above want 2 — not a victim: the script stops it (Р28); the victim — the greatest n ∈ {2…want} (ADR-0084 addendum (6); analysis of review of stage B 6–7, № 42)
want 1: the live number 2 above want — not a victim, nothing to shrink (Р28; № 42)
number 4 above want of its own server is not a victim; the victim — the greatest n ≤ want of its own server among the servers (№ 42)
number 3 above want; among n ≤ want equal numbers — the smaller server name first (№ 42)
want does not name the worker's server — input out of form (Р22; № 42)
want outside 1…99 — input out of form (Р22; № 42)

ADR-0127 P04 C1: a protected lower number is not the top candidate
ADR-0127 P04 C1: only n=want(s) can be reduced; no lower-number fallback
